claims.claim: The psychiatric-visit copay under the mental health basket is defined by treatment setting, not as a single national amount: community clinic and psychiatric-hospital outpatient clinic are charged at the secondary-physician tariff, general-hospital outpatient clinics at the standard outpatient tariff. claims.claim: Maccabi's published mental health entitlement: 2 assessment sessions (one diagnostic plus one treatment meeting) and a 15-session kartisiya within one year at Ministry of Health public clinics and hospital outpatient clinics; at private clinics under agreement, assessment plus a course of treatment at the therapist's discretion with no cap.
